name: Far Vigil
description: An ancient red dwarf holding station in the sparse halo, twelve billion years alight. One frozen world and a dwarf companion keep the long watch with it. The vigil's scopes look outward, past the galaxy's edge.

stars.name: Vigil Ember
stars.description: A red dwarf older than the disk it circles, burning with unchanging patience. It has outlived every star it formed beside. Its light is a museum of the early galaxy.

planets.name: Sentry
planets.description: A nitrogen-ice world staring outward past the galaxy's rim. Deep-space scopes cover its night side like barnacles. Its crew watches the void between galaxies for a living.

dwarfPlanets.name: Outpost Minor
dwarfPlanets.description: A dark ice dwarf even further out, hosting fuel caches for the extragalactic dreamers. Nobody lives here; everybody stops here. Its tanks have never once run dry.
